crossRefs.note: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them: you restore me, and cause me to live.
For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should…
I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so…
for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

translations.web: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
translations.bsb: They will be life to your soul and adornment to your neck.
translations.kjv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
translations.asv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, And grace to thy neck.
